name: Hadad
bio: Hadad, son of Bedad, succeeded Husham as king of Edom and was noted for defeating Midian in the field of Moab, ruling from the city of Avith; he is a different figure from the later Hadad who also reigned as a king of Edom, and from Hadad the Edomite who later troubled Solomon (Genesis 36:35-36; 36:39; 1 Kings 11:14-22).
